claim.value: Evaluation should check that apparent improvement does not consist merely of suppressing bookings.
claim.scope: An interpretation limit on apparent improvement, not an assertion that bookings have been suppressed.

provenance.rationale: P029 explicitly supplies the booking-suppression check and its limitation to apparent improvement.

signal_basis.value: Continue measuring late-start proportions, delay minutes and booking denominators through the trial, observing apparent sustained improvement across repeated periods.
signal_basis.scope: Trial evaluation using repeated measurements; apparent improvement alone does not establish whether bookings were suppressed.

provenance.rationale: These spans specify the measurements, continued trial observation, sustained-improvement signal and booking-suppression qualification.
The claim is supported without establishing a further empirical relation.

rationale: Suppressing bookings can reduce recorded delay burden or change which bookings contribute to late-start rates. Repeated apparent improvement therefore licenses checking whether the measured gain merely reflects suppressed bookings. The claim requires a check, not a finding that suppression occurred.
uncertainty: Whether bookings were actually suppressed remains undetermined; this does not weaken the warrant for checking.
